title: Downalod Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central icons (logos)
summary: The post provides download links for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central icons in multiple formats. It offers both the current Business Central icon and the older Dynamics 365 icon in PNG, SVG, and PDF formats with various sizes.
key_points: New Business Central icon available at aka.ms/BCicon
